caption: The video captures a single dancer with hair in a bun, wearing a black open-back long-sleeve top and a long dark blue-purple skirt, seen from behind in a bright white dance studio. The room has glossy floors, purple LED cove lighting, two black speakers high on the walls, ballet barres along the left, a black equipment cart on the right, and a full-width mirror behind that reflects the dancer. The dancer's arms, held low at the waist, rise upward in front of the body and extend overhead with hands joined in a pointed vertical position, held relatively still. The arms then bend and lower toward the chest and face, resting there while the torso stays upright. From this posture the dancer progressively folds the upper body forward and downward at the waist, the head dropping and the skirt shifting outward as the bending continues through the final frame.
